sources.title: Comparing Midjourney Plans (search-summarized, official docs page returned 403 to direct fetch)

keyLimits.en: 3.3 fast GPU hours/month, commercial usage rights.
15 fast GPU hours/month plus unlimited Relax-mode generations.
30 fast GPU hours/month, adds Stealth Mode (private, non-public generations).
60 fast GPU hours/month, highest generation throughput.

cautions.en: No free tier; every account requires a paid subscription to generate images. Fast GPU hours are the real usage constraint, not a simple image count.

capabilities.en: Text-to-image generation aimed at professional/commercial output quality.
Fast GPU mode for quick generations plus unlimited Relax mode on Standard and above.
Stealth Mode for private, non-publicly-visible generations, available from Pro upward.

limitations.en: No free trial or free tier; commitment requires an immediate paid subscription.
Privacy (Stealth Mode) is gated behind the Pro plan ($60/month), not available on Basic or Standard.

reason.en: Competing text-to-image model with comparable output quality.
Adobe's commercial-safe image generator, a direct alternative for professional use.
Competing AI image generation platform aimed at similar creative use cases.

unknowns: Official docs.midjourney.com pricing page returned HTTP 403 to direct fetch; figures here come from a search-engine synthesis of the same official page rather than a direct read, so exact wording (e.g. rounded GPU-hour numbers) should be re-verified locally.
